name: Ebino (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Ebino city emblem in white: a stylised angular device of a triangle above a chevron, like a mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Ebino, a city in Miyazaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 11 April 1974.

features.role: Ebino city emblem — a stylised angular device of a triangle above a chevron, like a mountain
